title: Exterior girder live load share by the lever rule (AASHTO LRFD)

answer_format.DF_lanes: number (lanes per girder, strength limit state)

rubric.text: The response should put the first wheel 0.6 m (2 ft) from the barrier face with 1.8 m (6 ft) to the second wheel, take moments about the first interior girder, and apply the one-lane multiple presence factor of 1.2.

expert_notes: Wheels at -0.1 m and 1.7 m from the exterior girder (0.7 - 0.6). Share = [(2.5 + 0.1) + (2.5 - 1.7)]/2.5/2 = 0.68 lane; x 1.2 = 0.816. With exact feet (0.6096 m, 1.8288 m) the result is 0.804, inside the tolerance.
